name: Palmetto Fur The Season
description: Palmetto Fur The Season was a seasonal mini furry convention held in major cities across South Carolina in 2025, organized by the Palmetto Anthro Collective. It was founded in January 2025 by vendors Peachylightz and BajaWerewolf, with the goal of collecting data and training staff for an eventual South Carolina furry convention, and it was succeeded by Palmetto Anthro Weekend. The first event, a spring festival, was the first furry mini convention in the state.
